name: ibm_cloud_iam_key_recognizer
note: IBM Cloud IAM API key: 44 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-] assigned to an (optional ibm/cloud/iam/api prefix +) key/pwd/password/pass/token variable. Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/ibm_cloud_iam.py (case-insensitive). The prefix is optional, so any 44-character token assigned to e.g. 'token' matches; the score is moderate and boosted when IBM context is nearby. Trailing lookahead approximated with \b; the match includes the variable name.
